subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode add a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a compact summary, and the requested behavior adds a new config and retained-message lifecycle rather than fixing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept default-off full preservation
options.body: Add a documented Telegram progress finalization option while preserving the current compact summary behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep compact summary only
options.body: Leave current main's one-line retained summary as the supported Telegram progress completion behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track full checklist retention as part of a broader cross-channel structured progress-card design.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off full preservation
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram progress finalization option while preserving the current compact summary behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey has recent targeted work and product-context commits in the Telegram progress finalization path this decision would change.
